conditions: Keep Router One API keys server-side under Vrooli's control; do not publish or hand them to downstream customers for their independent use.

Limit this interpretation to Router One pay-as-you-go usage in a Vrooli-operated service for Vrooli's own customers. The terms make subscription plans and enterprise contracts subject to their own plan or written agreement; those scopes are excluded here.

The customer portal, brand, support, billing, customer relationship and pricing remain Vrooli's responsibility; Router One does not provide a turnkey storefront, customer subaccounts, wholesale discount, or configurable markup.

For every model, separately capture the actual serving provider, model publisher/license, exact model/provider terms, current quote and live route availability; the Router One model ID/catalog is not proof of those rights.
Do not rely on self-serve PAYG for a contractual SLA. Trust/data handling and the Vrooli customer price remain separate human decisions.
